title: Selection-Based Structured Reasoning: Toward Efficient Multimodal Search Agents
title_zh: 基于选择的结构化推理：迈向高效的多模态搜索智能体

paragraphs.en: Multimodal agents commonly generate freeform reasoning before each action. For small models, limited model capacity can result in lengthy reasoning that provides little useful guidance for action generation while incurring substantial inference cost. To address this challenge, we introduce Selection-based Structured Reasoning (SSR), a framework that reformulates reasoning as selection instead of open-ended generation. SSR represents recurring high-level reasoning as pre-specified, reusable natural-language candidates. At each turn, the model selects from the reasoning candidates based on their likelihoods given the current context, without an auxiliary task head. Using pre-specified reasoning traces enables parallel scoring, where teacher-forced prefilling computes token likelihoods concurrently within and across candidates using a shared context KV cache. We evaluated SSR on seven multimodal search benchmarks using 2B and 4B models. Across multiple reinforcement learning objectives and supervised fine-tuning, SSR delivers significant efficiency gains without sacrificing task performance. SSR achieves an average success rate competitive with leading search agents of the same scale, while reducing per-turn reasoning latency by over 90% and total per-question model inference latency by 28–54%. Project page: https://zfy0314.github.io/ssr-webpage/ .

paragraphs.en: Multimodal agents turn textual and visual observations into actions: they analyze multimodal inputs, gather information, and use tools to resolve tasks that require multi-turn interactions ( He et al., 2024 ; Chng et al., 2025 ) . A common agent design interleaves observations, freeform reasoning, and actions ( Yao et al., 2022 ) . The reasoning step lets the model assess the available evidence and decide what to do next, but adds sequential token generation cost before every action. For small, on-device models with limited reasoning capacity, lengthy texts and repeated deliberations may waste the generation cost without providing useful guidance for generating better actions. An efficient agent needs reasoning that guides it to choose the desired action with minimal repeating cost of generating reasoning traces.
paragraphs.zh: 多模态智能体将文本和视觉观察结果转化为行动：它们分析多模态输入、收集信息，并使用工具来解决需要多轮交互的任务（He 等人，2024；Chng 等人，2025）。 一种常见的智能体设计将观察、自由形式推理和行动交替进行（Yao 等人，2022）。 推理步骤允许模型评估可用证据并决定下一步行动，但在每次行动之前都会增加顺序化的词元生成成本。 对于推理能力有限的小型本地模型而言，冗长的文本和反复的斟酌可能会浪费生成成本，而无法为生成更优的行动提供有效指导。 高效的智能体需要能够引导其选择预期行动的推理机制，同时尽可能减少生成推理痕迹的重复成本。

paragraphs.en: Existing approaches reduce this overhead by prompting concise traces or rewarding shorter reasoning ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Arora and Zanette, 2025 ) . These approaches reduce the amount of text generated, yet keep the sequential dependency between its tokens during autoregressive decoding. We investigate an orthogonal direction: changing the representation of reasoning itself. We observed that in multimodal search, entities, queries, and observations vary across questions, but the high-level reasoning for taking the next action often recurs. For example, finding the location of an upcoming AI conference and the year LEGO was founded can share the same rationale: the entity is known but the requested information is missing, so search for the entity name and the attribute of interest. Previous work on thought templates ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Ouyang et al., 2026 ) reported a similar finding, showing the value of reusing reasoning knowledge across problems. Therefore, the required reasoning space for search agents does not span the entire natural language space. Instead, the model can achieve a decent success rate with a few reasoning candidates to choose from.
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法通过提示简洁的推理轨迹或奖励更简短的推理过程来减少这种开销（Xu et al., 2025；Arora and Zanette, 2025）。 这些方法减少了生成的文本量，但在自回归解码过程中仍保留了其词元之间的序列依赖关系。 我们研究了一个正交方向：改变推理本身的表示方式。 我们观察到，在多模态搜索中，实体、查询和观察结果因问题而异，但采取下一步行动的高级推理往往具有重复性。 例如，查找即将举行的 AI 会议地点以及乐高成立年份这两个任务可以共享相同的推理逻辑：实体已知但所需信息缺失，因此需要搜索该实体名称和感兴趣的属性。 关于思维模板的先前研究（Yang et al., 2024；Ouyang et al., 2026）报告了类似的发现，表明在不同问题中重复使用推理知识的价值。 因此，搜索智能体所需的推理空间并不覆盖整个自然语言空间。 相反，模型只需从少数几个候选推理中选择，就能达到相当不错的成功率。

paragraphs.en: Motivated by this, we introduce Selection-based Structured Reasoning (SSR) , a framework that formulates reasoning as selection among reusable natural-language candidates instead of open-ended freeform generation. At each turn, the agent selects a reasoning candidate conditioned on its interaction history, then uses the selected reasoning to generate the next action and its arguments (e.g., a text search with a question-specific query). This design separates reusable reasoning patterns from instance-specific execution: the selected candidate provides the rationale for the next step, while action generation supplies the details needed to realize it. The agent then adapts its actions to the current context without generating freeform reasoning traces at any stage.
paragraphs.zh: 受此启发，我们提出了基于选择的结构化推理（SSR）框架，该框架将推理过程定义为在可重用的自然语言候选方案中进行选择，而非开放式自由形式生成。 在每个回合中，智能体会根据其交互历史选择一个推理候选方案，然后利用所选的推理来生成下一步行动及其参数（例如，使用特定问题的查询进行文本搜索）。 这种设计将可重用的推理模式与实例特定的执行过程分离开来：所选的候选方案为下一步提供依据，而行动生成则提供实现该步骤所需的细节。 随后，智能体能够根据当前上下文调整其行动，而无需在任何阶段生成自由形式的推理痕迹。

paragraphs.en: This representation enables parallel reasoning decoding (Figure 1 ). We use the language model directly as a candidate classifier, without any additional head, to score each reasoning candidate by its length-normalized likelihood conditioned on the current context. This leverages the language understanding capability of the model to match the context to the most suitable reasoning. Since all candidate tokens are pre-specified, teacher forcing computes token likelihoods in parallel within each reasoning candidate, and candidates are also scored concurrently sharing the same KV cache. The model then samples a reasoning candidate based on its score, and the harness inserts the selected reasoning into the model context as natural-language guidance for the next action.
paragraphs.zh: 这种表示方式支持并行推理解码（图 1）。 我们将语言模型直接用作候选分类器，无需任何额外头层，通过基于当前上下文的、经长度归一化的似然值来为每个推理候选打分。 这利用了模型的語言理解能力，将上下文与最合适的推理相匹配。 由于所有候选词元都是预先指定的，教师强制法可以在每个推理候选内部并行计算词元似然值，并且候选项也可以共享相同的 KV 缓存进行同步打分。 随后，模型会根据得分对推理候选进行采样，而执行器会将选定的推理作为自然语言指导插入到模型上下文中，以引导下一步操作。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate SSR across seven multimodal search benchmarks. Our 4B SSR with GRPO model achieves an average success rate of 61.37 % 61.37\% , matching the performance of leading trained 4B search agents ( 61.25 % 61.25\% ). Across GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , GSPO ( Zheng et al., 2025b ) , SAPO ( Gao et al., 2025 ) , and SFT, the SSR agents achieve comparable task performance while significantly reducing model inference latency compared to the freeform reasoning counterpart. Against four representative efficient reasoning baselines, SSR achieves a higher success rate, lower model inference time, and more consistent latency.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在七个多模态搜索基准上对 SSR 进行了评估。 我们的配备 GRPO 的 4B SSR 模型实现了 61.37% 的平均成功率，与领先的训练过的 4B 搜索智能体的性能（61.25%）相当。 在 GRPO（Shao 等人，2024）、GSPO（Zheng 等人，2025b）、SAPO（Gao 等人，2025）和 SFT 中，SSR 智能体实现了可比较的任务性能，同时与自由形式推理版本相比显著降低了模型推理延迟。 与四个具有代表性的高效推理基线方法相比，SSR 实现了更高的成功率、更低的模型推理时间和更稳定的延迟。

paragraphs.en: Reasoning by selection rather than generation. We introduce Selection-based Structured Reasoning (SSR), which replaces freeform reasoning with selection among reusable natural language candidates conditioned on the current context.
paragraphs.zh: 通过选择而非生成进行推理。 我们提出了基于选择的结构化推理（SSR），该方法用根据当前上下文条件，在可重用的自然语言候选项中进行选择的方式，取代了自由形式的推理。

paragraphs.en: Prior work trained multimodal agents to interleave perception, retrieval, and tool use. In multimodal search, MMSearch-R1 ( Wu et al., 2025 ) and DeepMMSearch-R1 ( Narayan et al., 2025 ) trained models to use text and image search, while Visual-ARFT ( Liu et al., 2025 ) and DeepEyes ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) added image operations such as cropping and zooming. DeepEyesV2 ( Hong et al., 2026 ) combined image operations with code execution and web search. SenseNova-MARS ( Chng et al., 2025 ) , TAPO ( Dong et al., 2026 ) , and WebWatcher ( Geng et al., 2025 ) investigated multi-turn reinforcement learning, tool-aware credit assignment, and deep-research behavior. More recent systems extended the scale and supervision of this recipe: VSearcher trained long-horizon search over text, images, and webpages ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , while ProMMSearchAgent introduced process-oriented rewards in a static sandbox before transfer to live search ( Yan et al., 2026 ) . These approaches focused on training-data mixtures, gradient routing, and credit assignment for performance improvements, while we explore an orthogonal direction that improves inference efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的工作训练了多模态智能体，使其能够交替执行感知、检索和工具使用。 在多模态搜索中，MMSearch-R1（Wu 等人，2025）和 DeepMMSearch-R1（Narayan 等人，2025）训练模型使用文本和图像搜索，而 Visual-ARFT（Liu 等人，2025）和 DeepEyes（Zheng 等人，2026）则增加了裁剪和缩放等图像操作。 DeepEyesV2（Hong 等人，2026）将图像操作与代码执行和网络搜索相结合。 SenseNova-MARS（Chng 等人，2025）、TAPO（Dong 等人，2026）和 WebWatcher（Geng 等人，2025）研究了多回合强化学习、工具感知的信用分配以及深度研究行为。 更近期的系统扩展了这一方法的规模和监督范围：VSearcher 在文本、图像和网页上训练了长期搜索（Zhang 等人，2026），而 ProMMSearchAgent 则在转移到实时搜索之前，在一个静态沙盒中引入了流程导向的奖励（Yan 等人，2026）。 这些方法专注于通过混合训练数据、梯度路由和信用分配来提升性能，而我们则探索了一个正交方向，即提高推理效率。

paragraphs.en: Efficient-reasoning methods controlled model deliberation through token budgets, early stopping, compressed chains of thought, or adaptive test-time computation ( Han et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2025 ; Sui et al., 2025 ) . Agentic settings add another resource axis: the model must decide not only how long to think, but also whether to spend the next unit of budget on retrieval, interaction, or answer commitment. Inference-time budget control for search agents explicitly modeled this trade-off ( Fang et al., 2026 ) . Closest to our efficiency goal, HyperEyes ( Li et al., 2026 ) treated inference efficiency as a first-class training objective: it dispatched multiple grounded queries concurrently within a round and rewarded trajectories that avoided superfluous tool calls, reducing the number of interaction rounds, whereas we reduce the cost of the reasoning span within each round. Grammar-constrained decoding enforced admissible output forms ( Geng et al., 2023 ) , with engines such as XGrammar reducing the cost of constraint checking ( Dong et al., 2025 ) . SSR instead scores complete candidates in parallel and directly supplies the selected text as the reasoning trace.
paragraphs.zh: 高效推理方法通过令牌预算、提前停止、压缩思维链或自适应测试时计算来控制模型审议（Han et al., 2025；Ma et al., 2025；Sui et al., 2025）。 智能体设置引入了另一个资源维度：模型不仅要决定思考多久，还要决定是否将下一个预算单位用于检索、交互或确定答案。 搜索智能体的推理时预算控制明确建模了这一权衡（Fang et al., 2026）。 最接近我们效率目标的是 HyperEyes（Li et al., 2026），它将推理效率视为一等训练目标：它在每个回合内并发执行多个基于事实的查询，并奖励那些避免多余工具调用的轨迹，从而减少交互回合数；而我们的方法则是降低每个回合内推理阶段的成本。 语法约束解码强制要求输出符合允许的形式（Geng et al., 2023），而像 XGrammar 这样的引擎则降低了约束检查的成本（Dong et al., 2025）。 SSR 则并行评分完整的候选答案，并直接将选中的文本作为推理痕迹提供。

paragraphs.en: Prior work explored reusable knowledge through thought templates ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , context-aware guidelines ( Fu et al., 2024 ) , reasoning memories ( Ouyang et al., 2026 ) , and task workflows ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . Given a library of reasoning candidates, SSR directly uses the acting MLLM’s internal semantic knowledge to select among them through context-conditioned likelihoods, without any auxiliary knowledge-management or retrieval system. Trajectory-level approaches such as StraTA ( Xue et al., 2026 ) generated a strategy from the initial task state and kept that strategy fixed throughout the interaction. SSR instead selects a reasoning candidate at every turn based on the updated interaction history, allowing new observations to change the guidance for subsequent actions. Programmatic approaches ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2025a ) encoded reusable skills as fixed, executable programs. An SSR candidate instead supplies natural-language guidance that biases action generation without prescribing executable control flow. This leaves concrete queries, tool arguments, and answers flexible, allowing the same reasoning candidate to support different actions across contexts without modifying the candidate itself.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的研究通过思维模板（Yang et al., 2024）、上下文感知指南（Fu et al., 2024）、推理记忆（Ouyang et al., 2026）和任务工作流程（Wang et al., 2025）探索了可重用的知识。 给定一个推理候选库，SSR 直接利用执行 MLLM 的内部语义知识，通过上下文条件化的可能性在这些候选中做出选择，而无需任何辅助的知识管理或检索系统。 像 StraTA（Xue et al., 2026）这样的轨迹级方法会从初始任务状态生成一个策略，并在整个交互过程中保持该策略不变。 相比之下，SSR 会在每一步基于更新后的交互历史选择一个推理候选，从而允许新的观察结果改变后续行动的指导方针。 程序化方法（Wang et al., 2023；Zheng et al., 2025a）将可重用的技能编码为固定的、可执行的程序。 而 SSR 候选则提供自然语言指导，用于引导行动生成，而不规定具体的可执行控制流程。 这使得具体的查询、工具参数和答案保持灵活，因此同一个推理候选无需修改自身，就能在不同上下文中支持不同的行动。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Selection-based Structured Reasoning (SSR) , which replaces freeform reasoning in ReAct agents ( Yao et al., 2022 ) with selection among reusable reasoning candidates.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了基于选择的结构化推理（Selection-based Structured Reasoning，简称 SSR），该方法将 ReAct 智能体（Yao et al., 2022）中的自由形式推理替换为在可重用的推理候选方案中进行选择。

paragraphs.en: At turn t t , the interaction history of an agent is h t = [ x , z 0 , a 0 , o 0 , … , z t − 1 , a t − 1 , o t − 1 ] h_{t}=[x,z_{0},a_{0},o_{0},\ldots,z_{t-1},a_{t-1},o_{t-1}] , where x x is the initial user request, z i z_{i} is a reasoning trace, a i a_{i} is an action, and o i o_{i} is the observation returned by an external tool. A tool call extends the history with a new observation, while a final answer terminates the trajectory. Conventionally, an MLLM with distribution p θ p_{\theta} generates a freeform reasoning trace z t ∼ p θ ( ⋅ ∣ h t ) z_{t}\sim p_{\theta}(\cdot\mid h_{t}) before generating the action a t ∼ p θ ( ⋅ ∣ h t , z t ) a_{t}\sim p_{\theta}(\cdot\mid h_{t},z_{t}) . Since z t z_{t} is unconstrained natural-language text, its tokens must be decoded autoregressively, resulting in substantial inference latency.

paragraphs.en: To eliminate this sequential decoding cost, SSR selects z t z_{t} from reusable natural-language candidates conditioned on h t h_{t} , instead of generating it token by token (Figure 2 ). SSR contains a reasoning library ℛ = { r 1 , … , r N } \mathcal{R}=\{r_{1},\ldots,r_{N}\} , which consists of short natural-language candidates. Each candidate is a reusable reasoning trace that describes what information is available or missing in the current context and what step to take next. Parallel reasoning decoding uses the language model itself to score the full text of each candidate conditioned on h t h_{t} and select one as z t z_{t} . Since all candidate texts are specified in advance, their token likelihoods can be computed with teacher-forced prefill and different candidates can be scored in parallel. The selected reasoning is then inserted into the context to guide instance-specific action generation, such as a search query, crop location, or final answer. This formulation leverages the semantics prior in the language decoder for reasoning selection, and makes use of the natural-language guidance for the action generation.
paragraphs.zh: 为了消除这种顺序解码的成本，SSR 会根据 h t h_{t} 从可重用的自然语言候选项中选择 z t z_{t}，而不是逐个词元生成（图 2）。 SSR 包含一个推理库 ℛ = { r 1 , … , r N } \mathcal{R}=\{r_{1},\ldots,r_{N}\}，由简短的自然语言候选项组成。 每个候选项都是一个可重用的推理轨迹，描述了当前上下文中哪些信息可用或缺失，以及接下来应采取的步骤。 并行推理解码利用语言模型本身，根据 h t h_{t} 为每个候选项的完整文本打分，并选择其中一个作为 z t z_{t}。 由于所有候选文本都已提前指定，因此可以通过教师强制预填充计算其词元似然度，并且可以对不同候选项进行并行打分。 随后，将选定的推理插入到上下文中，以指导针对具体实例的动作生成，例如搜索查询、裁剪位置或最终答案。 这种设计利用了语言解码器中的语义先验来进行推理选择，并借助自然语言引导来执行动作生成。

paragraphs.en: SSR provides a general alternative to freeform reasoning under both supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) objectives. At each turn, the policy makes a categorical reasoning selection and then autoregressively generates the action and its arguments. The reasoning-selection and action-generation objectives share the same model parameters and can be optimized jointly in an end-to-end manner.
paragraphs.zh: SSR 在监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）目标下，为自由形式推理提供了一种通用的替代方案。 在每个回合中，策略会先做出一个分类推理选择，然后自回归地生成动作及其参数。 推理选择和动作生成的目标共享相同的模型参数，并且可以以端到端的方式联合优化。

paragraphs.en: We use the 2B/4B Qwen3-VL ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) models for our experiments. Following the aforementioned prior work, we use the same tool harness with reverse-image search, text search, and image cropping, as well as the same LLM-as-judge for evaluation. Our reasoning library contains six manually written reasoning candidates shared across benchmarks (details in Appendix E ): (1) doing an image search to identify the entity when unsure, (2) looking up specific information through a text search, (3) zooming into a specific part of the image for targeted inspection, (4) answering the question from the gathered evidence, (5) answering the question based on the image, and (6) answering with general knowledge. Each of them covers a general case that the search agent may encounter. Unless otherwise noted, we train each RL model in a single stage for one epoch with a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} using outcome and format rewards. For simplicity, we set λ reason SFT = γ reason RL = 1 \lambda^{\text{SFT}}_{\text{reason}}=\gamma^{\mathrm{RL}}_{\mathrm{reason}}=1 and β = 10 − 3 \beta=10^{-3} . Appendix F contains additional implementation details.

paragraphs.en: We report success rate on all seven multimodal search benchmarks and inference efficiency. For latency profiling, we sample 100 100 questions per benchmark and measure per-turn reasoning latency (time to produce the reasoning trace) and per-question model latency (prefill, reasoning, action generation, and other model inference over the full trajectory). We report mean and 95th-percentile latency. Environment-side processing, including tool execution and LLM-as-judge evaluation, is excluded as it introduces excessive model-independent variations. We also report effective reasoning throughput, computed as the total number of reasoning tokens processed divided by the total reasoning time. For SSR, this counts all candidate tokens being scored in parallel. For autoregressive generation, it counts the tokens in the generated reasoning trace. We run the profiling on an NVIDIA H100 GPU with an offline SGLang ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) inference engine.
paragraphs.zh: 我们报告了所有七个多模态搜索基准测试的成功率以及推理效率。 在延迟分析中，我们对每个基准测试采样 100 个问题，并测量每次轮次的推理延迟（生成推理轨迹所需的时间）以及每个问题的模型延迟（预填充、推理、动作生成以及整个轨迹上的其他模型推理）。 我们报告了平均延迟和第 95 百分位延迟。 环境侧的处理（包括工具执行和 LLM 作为评判者的评估）被排除在外，因为这会引入过多的与模型无关的变量。 我们还报告了有效推理吞吐量，其计算方式为：处理的推理令牌总数除以总推理时间。 对于 SSR，这统计了所有并行评分的候选令牌。 对于自回归生成，这统计了生成的推理轨迹中的令牌数量。 我们在配备离线 SGLang（Zheng et al., 2024）推理引擎的 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上运行了该分析。

paragraphs.en: We first compare SSR with the state-of-the-art multimodal search agents. Table 1 shows that the 4B SSR model reaches 61.37 % 61.37\% average success rate, comparable to the best 4B SOTA model TAPO with GSPO at 61.25 % 61.25\% and outperforms 4B MMSearch-R1 and SenseNova-MARS baselines. The 2B SSR agent reaches 51.26 % 51.26\% , comparable to the zero-shot 8B model, showing the generalization of the approach to a smaller backbone. These results show that selecting reusable reasoning can support competitive success rates in multimodal agentic search tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先将 SSR 与当前最先进的多模态搜索智能体进行比较。 表 1 显示，4B SSR 模型的平均成功率为 61.37 % 61.37\%，与采用 GSPO 的最佳 4B SOTA 模型 TAPO（成功率为 61.25 % 61.25\%）相当，并优于 4B MMSearch-R1 和 SenseNova-MARS 基线模型。 2B SSR 智能体的成功率为 51.26 % 51.26\%，与零样本 8B 模型相当，表明该方法能够推广到更小的骨干网络。 这些结果表明，选择可重用的推理能力可以在多模态智能体搜索任务中支持具有竞争力的成功率。

paragraphs.en: SSR brings more than 90 % 90\% reduction to the per-turn freeform reasoning latency and reduces mean per-question model latency by 28 28 - 54 % 54\% . Scoring complete candidates in parallel removes the sequential generation of the reasoning trace, yielding higher effective reasoning throughput that matches the token processing speed during prefill. These results show consistent latency benefits across different training methods.

paragraphs.en: To compare SSR with existing efficient-reasoning methods, we compare four baselines spanning three approaches: prompt-based compression with Chain-of-Draft ( Xu et al., 2025 ) and Sketch-of-Thought ( Aytes et al., 2025 ) , learning shorter reasoning through efficiency-reward RL ( Arora and Zanette, 2025 ) , and optional reasoning trace decoding with a lightweight classification head in Probe & Prefill ( Sun et al., 2026 ) . We implement the efficiency baselines on the GRPO-freeform pipeline for a fair comparison and report the results in Table 3 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了将 SSR 与现有的高效推理方法进行比较，我们对比了涵盖三种方法的四种基线：基于提示的压缩方法，包括 Chain-of-Draft（Xu et al., 2025）和 Sketch-of-Thought（Aytes et al., 2025）；通过效率奖励强化学习来学习更简短的推理过程（Arora and Zanette, 2025）；以及在 Probe & Prefill（Sun et al., 2026）中采用轻量级分类头进行可选的推理轨迹解码。 为了进行公平比较，我们在 GRPO-freeform 流程上实现了这些效率基线，并将结果报告在表 3 中。

paragraphs.en: SSR achieves the highest success rate and delivers approximately 7 × 7\times or greater speedup in reasoning on all baselines. The gains extend to question-level: mean model latency is around 2.5 ​ s 2.5s , approximately 30 % 30\% lower than Sketch-of-Thought, the fastest baseline on this metric. These results show that parallel reasoning decoding is a more effective than reasoning-compression methods at reducing latency while maintaining high success rate.

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive decoding can also generate the specified reasoning candidate when the model is trained to use the library entries. With an SFT warm start followed by RL with a format reward, the 4B model reproduces reasoning-library entries and achieves average success comparable to parallel reasoning decoding. However, without SFT, specifying in the prompt and applying a format reward during RL cannot enforce using only the reasoning candidates from the library, and the model instead generates freeform reasoning. Thus, the autoregressive variant must learn to conform to the reasoning library, whereas our reasoning selection enforces this interface directly. Additionally, parallel full-text scoring further removes the sequential generation of the selected reasoning candidate, combining effective reasoning with lower decoding latency.
paragraphs.zh: 当模型被训练为使用知识库条目时，自回归解码也能生成指定的推理候选答案。 通过 SFT 预热启动，再结合带有格式奖励的 RL，该 4B 模型能够复现知识库中的推理条目，并实现与并行推理解码相当的平均成功率。 然而，在没有 SFT 的情况下，仅通过在提示中指定并在 RL 阶段应用格式奖励，无法强制模型只使用知识库中的推理候选答案，模型反而会生成自由形式的推理内容。 因此，自回归变体必须学会遵循知识库的推理格式，而我们的推理选择方法则直接强制执行这一接口规范。 此外，并行全文评分还能进一步消除所选推理候选答案的序列生成过程，从而将高效的推理与更低的解码延迟相结合。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 shows that the same model yields different distributions of reasoning selection across different benchmarks. paragraphs.en: We presented Selection-based Structured Reasoning (SSR) , which reformulates reasoning in small multimodal search agents as selection rather than open-ended generation. SSR captures recurring high-level reasoning as reusable natural-language candidates and selects among them based on their likelihoods under the current context. Pre-specified candidates enable teacher-forced parallel scoring within and across candidates, eliminating token-by-token reasoning generation. Across seven multimodal search benchmarks, SSR achieves competitive task performance while reducing per-turn reasoning latency by over 90 % 90\% and total per-question model inference latency by 28 28 - 54 % 54\% . More broadly, our results suggest that small search agents may not need to reason over the full language space at every step, and that organizing recurring reasoning into a compact, reusable space can enable more efficient multimodal agents.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了基于选择的结构化推理（SSR），它将小型多模态搜索智能体中的推理过程重新定义为选择，而非开放式生成。 SSR 将重复出现的高级推理捕捉为可重用的自然语言候选项，并根据当前上下文中的可能性在这些候选项之间进行选择。 预定义的候选项使得在候选项内部和跨候选项的“教师强制”并行评分成为可能，从而消除了逐词推理生成。 在七个多模态搜索基准测试中，SSR 实现了具有竞争力的任务性能，同时将每次轮次的推理延迟降低了超过 90%（90\%），每道题的模型推理总延迟降低了 28% 至 54%（28 - 54\%）。 更广泛地说，我们的结果表明，小型搜索智能体可能无需在每一步都针对整个语言空间进行推理，而将重复出现的推理组织成一个紧凑且可重用的空间，则能够构建出更高效的多模态智能体。

paragraphs.en: A straightforward procedure to construct the reasoning library is to sample training questions and successful freeform reasoning traces, group recurring information needs, and summarize them into a small set of reusable reasoning candidates. Each candidate describes how to make progress without retaining question-specific entities or answers. Ideally, the set of candidates should cover all states that the agent will encounter. Future work could explore skill-evolution methods such as SkillOpt ( Yang et al., 2026 ) to construct and refine the reasoning library automatically from trajectory feedback.
paragraphs.zh: 构建推理库的一个直接方法是：对训练问题和成功的自由形式推理轨迹进行采样，将重复出现的信息需求进行分组，并将其总结为一组可重复使用的推理候选方案。 每个候选方案都描述了如何推进任务，而无需保留与特定问题相关的实体或答案。 理想情况下，这组候选方案应覆盖智能体将会遇到的所有状态。 未来的研究可以探索技能演化方法（例如 SkillOpt (Yang et al., 2026)），以从轨迹反馈中自动构建和优化推理库。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on seven publicly available multimodal search benchmarks that collectively span a broad range of retrieval difficulty, temporal freshness, and image resolution requirements. We use the benchmark versions distributed in the SenseNova evaluation collection ( Chng et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在七个公开可用的多模态搜索基准数据集上进行评估，这些数据集共同涵盖了检索难度、时效性和图像分辨率要求的广泛范围。 我们使用 SenseNova 评估集（Chng 等人，2025）中分发的基准版本。

paragraphs.en: ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) contains 300 manually collected questions spanning 14 subfields, of which 171 are accompanied by an image; its News area covers events from May to August 2024, testing the model’s ability to ground visual observations in up-to-date factual knowledge. We follow the standard split of 171 questions used for system-level evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: (Jiang et al., 2024) 包含 300 个手动收集的问题，涵盖 14 个子领域，其中 171 个问题附有图像；其新闻部分涵盖了 2024 年 5 月至 8 月的事件，用于测试模型将视觉观察与最新事实知识结合的能力。 我们遵循系统级评估所用的 171 个问题的标准划分方式。

paragraphs.en: ( Chng et al., 2025 ) is a knowledge-intensive benchmark comprising 305 questions paired with high-resolution (4K) images sourced from international news agencies (2025 events), spanning eight topical domains. Approximately 60% of questions are classified as hard, requiring three or more tool invocations to answer correctly.
paragraphs.zh: （Chng 等人，2025）是一项知识密集型基准测试，包含 305 个问题，并配有来自国际新闻机构（2025 年事件）的高分辨率（4K）图像，涵盖八个主题领域。 约 60% 的问题被归类为难题，需要三次或更多次工具调用才能正确回答。

paragraphs.en: ( Wu et al., 2025 ) is a curated 1,800-sample test set consisting of three equal-sized subsets: FVQA-auto-vc (600 automatically constructed samples, each manually checked for correctness and disjoint from the training set), InfoSeek Human Split (600 samples with manually corrected annotations), and an expert-annotated subset (600 samples).
paragraphs.zh: （Wu 等人，2025）是一个经过精心整理的包含 1,800 个样本的测试集，由三个大小相等的子集组成：FVQA-auto-vc（600 个自动构建的样本，每个样本都经过人工检查以确保正确性，且与训练集互斥）、InfoSeek Human Split（600 个带有经人工修正的标注的样本），以及一个由专家标注的子集（600 个样本）。

paragraphs.en: ( Chen et al., 2023 ) is a visual question answering dataset for information-seeking questions that cannot be answered through commonsense reasoning alone. It is built on visual entity recognition and grounded in Wikidata, targeting fine-grained factual attributes that models do not reliably surface without retrieval. We sample 2,000 instances from its test split.
paragraphs.zh: (Chen et al., 2023) 是一个用于信息类问答的视觉问答数据集，这些问题无法仅通过常识推理来回答。 该数据集基于视觉实体识别并以 Wikidata 为根基，专注于模型在没有检索支持时难以可靠呈现的细粒度事实属性。 我们从其测试集中采样了 2,000 个实例。

paragraphs.en: ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) focuses on factual accuracy, combining post-2023 VQA instances with expert-curated image-question pairs across 1,013 English samples.
paragraphs.zh: （Cheng 等人，2025）聚焦于事实准确性，将 2023 年之后的 VQA 实例与专家精选的图像-问题配对相结合，共涵盖 1,013 个英语样本。

paragraphs.en: ( Fu et al., 2025 ) aggregates 3,602 image-question pairs from major news outlets, including CNN and BBC, spanning 14 thematic categories, and emphasizes temporal reasoning over recently published content.
paragraphs.zh: （Fu 等人，2025）从包括 CNN 和 BBC 在内的主要新闻机构中收集了 3,602 个图像-问题对，涵盖 14 个主题类别，并强调对近期发布内容的时序推理。

paragraphs.en: ( Liu et al., 2025 ) is a manually crafted and human-verified benchmark of 150 examples designed to evaluate agentic multimodal reasoning, requiring models to handle composite multi-hop queries, retrieve external information, and invoke tools effectively across varying reasoning depths.
paragraphs.zh: （Liu et al., 2025）是一个由人工构建并经人类验证的基准数据集，包含150个示例，旨在评估智能体的多模态推理能力。该数据集要求模型能够处理复合的多跳查询、检索外部信息，并在不同推理深度下有效调用工具。

paragraphs.en: The default library contains six manually written reasoning candidates (Table 6 ). Each entry is a single short natural-language statement describing how to make progress from the current state . The library is fixed throughout training and evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 默认库包含六个手动编写的推理候选方案（表 6）。 每个条目都是一个简短的自然语言陈述，描述了如何从当前状态取得进展。 该库在训练和评估过程中始终保持不变。

paragraphs.en: We adapt the multimodal-search setup of TAPO ( Dong et al., 2026 ) . The agent is trained directly with RL, without an SFT warm-up, using VeRL, a global batch size of 64, learning rate 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} , and 8 8 rollouts per GRPO group. Each trajectory permits at most 10 interaction rounds during training, 8,192 generated tokens per round, and 32,768 tokens across the full trajectory. If it exceeds any of these, it will be marked as incorrect. Text retrieval during training uses a local Wikipedia retrieval index to reduce cost and evaluation uses web search through Serp API.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用了 TAPO（Dong 等人，2026）的多模态搜索设置。 智能体通过强化学习直接训练，无需 SFT 预热阶段，使用 VeRL、全局批量大小为 64、学习率 1 × 10⁻⁵ 以及每个 GRPO 组 8 次 rollout。 在训练期间，每条轨迹最多允许 10 轮交互，每轮生成 8,192 个 token，整条轨迹的 token 总数不超过 32,768 个。 如果超出上述任何限制，该轨迹将被标记为错误。 训练期间的文本检索使用本地维基百科检索索引以降低成本，而评估阶段则通过 Serp API 进行网络搜索。

paragraphs.en: The agent can choose among three information-acquisition tools and a terminal answer: (i) image_search_tool , which performs reverse-image search on the question image and returns image captions; (ii) text_search_tool(query) , which performs query-specified search and returns a Qwen3-32B-generated summary; (iii) image_zoom_in_tool(bbox) , which crops a bounding box and returns the resulting image patch; and (iv) a terminal <answer> action. At every non-terminal turn, the base protocol expects a thinking block followed by exactly one <tool_call> conforming to the JSON schema; SSR supplies the thinking block through candidate selection while retaining the same tool-call schema.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体可以从三种信息获取工具和一个最终答案中进行选择：(i) image_search_tool，它会对问题图像执行反向图像搜索并返回图像标题；(ii) text_search_tool(query)，它会执行由查询指定的搜索并返回由 Qwen3-32B 生成的摘要；(iii) image_zoom_in_tool(bbox)，它会裁剪一个边界框并返回生成的图像片段；以及 (iv) 一个最终的 <answer> 动作。 在每个非最终回合中，基础协议要求先有一个思考块，然后是一个严格符合 JSON 模式的 <tool_call>；SSR 通过候选选择提供思考块，同时保留相同的工具调用模式。

paragraphs.en: For RL, we use a combination of accuracy reward and format reward.
paragraphs.zh: 对于强化学习（RL），我们结合了准确性奖励和格式奖励。

paragraphs.en: Non-multiple-choice questions are judged by Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct with greedy decoding and temperature zero given the image, question, ground truth, and the final answer generated by the model. Multiple-choice questions use exact match. Format reward is model-dependent: all conditions have to generate valid <think> delimiters and correct tool call format; SSR models (including the index-only variant) additionally have to use the expected tool of each reasoning that they select for full format reward, otherwise they only get partial format reward for the correct tool call format; the autoregressive structured reasoning model gets the format reward only if it generates reasoning in the library with exact match.
paragraphs.zh: 非选择题由 Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct 根据图像、问题、标准答案以及模型生成的最终答案，通过贪心解码和零温度设置进行评分。 选择题采用完全匹配方式评分。 格式奖励因模型而异：所有模型都必须生成有效的 <think> 分隔符和正确的工具调用格式；SSR 模型（包括仅索引的变体）还必须在其推理过程中使用的每个预期工具上完全符合格式要求才能获得完整的格式奖励，否则仅能获得部分格式奖励（即正确的工具调用格式奖励）；自回归结构化推理模型只有在库中生成完全匹配的推理内容时才能获得格式奖励。

paragraphs.en: We compare no thinking, freeform reasoning, and SSR (ours) under GRPO with the Qwen3-VL-4B backbone.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在基于 Qwen3-VL-4B 主干模型的情况下，对比了无思考、自由形式推理以及我们提出的 SSR（在 GRPO 框架下）三种方法。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 compares no thinking, freeform reasoning, and SSR under GRPO. The unweighted mean success rate across the seven benchmarks is 58.91 % 58.91\% , 58.65 % 58.65\% , and 61.37 % 61.37\% , respectively. SSR therefore improves the benchmark mean by 2.47 2.47 percentage points over no thinking and 2.72 2.72 points over freeform reasoning. Freeform reasoning is 0.26 0.26 points below no thinking on this aggregate, so generating a freeform reasoning trace does not by itself consistently improve task performance in this comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 图 5 比较了无思考、自由形式推理和 GRPO 下的 SSR。 七个基准测试中未加权平均成功率分别为 58.91% 58.91\%、58.65% 58.65\% 和 61.37% 61.37\%。 因此，SSR 使基准测试的平均成绩比无思考高出 2.47 2.47 个百分点，比自由形式推理高出 2.72 2.72 个百分点。 在此汇总结果中，自由形式推理比无思考低 0.26 0.26 个百分点，因此仅生成自由形式推理轨迹本身并不能在此比较中持续提高任务性能。

paragraphs.en: SSR outperforms no thinking on all seven benchmarks (7/7), with gains ranging from 0.99 0.99 to 7.34 7.34 percentage points. In contrast, freeform reasoning improves over no thinking on only two of seven benchmarks with the same Qwen3-VL-4B backbone under GRPO. SSR improves over no thinking across all seven benchmarks whereas freeform does not outperform no thinking on all of the benchmarks. SSR also exceeds freeform reasoning on five of seven benchmarks, with HR-MMSearch and MAT-Search favoring freeform reasoning.
